meta.title: DuoUpdater — update each Mac app its own way
meta.description: Finds updates for your Mac apps and installs each one its own way.

footer.appClaim: No tracking. Installs are counted anonymously.

hero.body: Finds updates for your Mac apps and installs them in one click.

download.note: Free and open source · Apple silicon · macOS 15+

menuBar.alt: The DuoUpdater menu bar popover, headed 89 updates available with an Update All button and a search field. Each row shows the installed version, the new version, a small badge for what the app is built with, and an Update button; Anki's row reads 26.9.2 to 26.09.3. A hover card over BetterDisplay's badge reads: Native — a native Mac app, built straight on Apple's frameworks, not a cross-platform runtime. Links AppKit and SwiftUI. Built with the macOS 27.0 SDK. Two rows at the bottom: Homebrew, 9 updates and 3 not checked; Other tools, 1 update and 1 held back.
menuBar.title: At a glance
menuBar.body: See what’s new and what’s running.

handsOver.title: Defers to the app
handsOver.body: Apps with their own updater use it.

neverForceQuits.title: Never force-quits
neverForceQuits.body: Quits like you would, so you can save.

workbench.alt: The workbench window: a sidebar listing every scanned app, and the release notes for the selected one rendered as native text — version heading, date, and one bullet per change.
workbench.title: Release notes
workbench.body: Read what changed, right in the app.

cli.alt: The workbench's CLI tab: a sidebar grouping command-line tools by how they were installed — Homebrew, npm under nvm and fnm, Claude Code, bub, fx, uv, Junie, Rust and Codex — each with its path and version. Claude Code is selected: installed by the native installer, version 2.1.295 matching Anthropic's release manifest, signed by Anthropic, on the latest channel and up to date, with its release notes listed by version beside it.
cli.title: Command line

releaseLog.alt: The Release Log timeline: releases grouped by day, each showing the app, version, source, and either an exact publish time or an approximate window.
releaseLog.title: Release log
releaseLog.body: A log of when your apps ship.

settings.alt: DuoUpdater's General settings, beside a sidebar listing Backups, Folders, Updates, GitHub, Alcove, Xcode, Ignored and Diagnostics: launch at login, check interval, hiding the Dock icon, whether to show what each app is built with, notifications, automatic relaunch, how many apps to check at once, and install routing for App Store updates, self-updating apps, apps without a developer signature and TestFlight betas.
settings.title: Your call
settings.body: You decide how much it does for you.

xcode.alt: The Xcode settings page: signed in to Apple Developer, with an option to renew the session in the background. Below, a Download Xcode list with Betas & RCs and Releases tabs, from Apple and xcodereleases.com, showing Xcode 27 builds from 27.2 beta 2 down to 27.0 beta 4, each with its date and the macOS it requires. Most have an Install button; the two already installed, as Xcode-beta.app and Xcode.app, offer Open and Download Only (.xip).
